title: Heart Sutra, Part 4: Form is Emptiness
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up the Heart Sutra's line "form does not differ from emptiness," after a review of the five skandhas as a way to loosen the grip of "everything is happening to me." Nomon explains emptiness as emptiness of separateness, and offers a seed that becomes a tree only through sun, water, and undisturbed habitat. An old Volkswagen bus that broke down and brought help from strangers shows what happens when we expect form to stay solid. Nomon points to Thich Nhat Hanh's chapter "Long Live Emptiness," leads a space-seeing exercise around the room, and closes with a meditation on Jeff Foster's poem "Peeling Off the Label."
